doc.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020

title: Never retiring, and Clark Terry's saying
summary: He will keep playing as long as he can, quoting Clark Terry on leaving people feeling better.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Right. When’s that guy going to retire?

That’s right. Don’t do it anytime — you know my philosophy of retiring is I probably never will. As long as I can still play and do that kind of stuff, and for me music is to touch the lives positively of others. Clark Terry said something once I’ll never forget. He said you know what I want people to feel better when they leave than when they come in.
